_notes: Maps variant location strings to one canonical venue key so events at the same physical venue dedup even when sources name it differently.
Shape: {"canonical-key": ["alias", ...]}. Aliases are lowercased and matched first exactly, then as substrings, in file order.
Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the loader (scripts/event_store.py: _load_location_aliases).
moves-vibes: Moves & Vibes (Cambridge) is scraped as 'Dance Co', 'Dancing Academy' and 'Dance and Entertainment Co', with the street as both '5th' and 'Fifth'.

la-fabrica-central: appears with and without the accent. The bare '450 Massachusetts Ave' is deliberately NOT aliased: special one-off editions are listed by address only and must not be swallowed into the series.
el-barco: appears by name and as a bare address.
wallys-cafe: appears with an accented apostrophe and with 'EE. UU.' vs 'USA' country suffix across sources.
hatch-shell: docks near the hatch memorial shell
dante-alighieri: the dante alighieri society of massachusetts
magazine-beach: mass audubon magazine beach park nature center
